title: kk7.4: CORS + landing page tests
description:
What: Write tests for CORS middleware and GET / landing page in crates/mail/src/server.rs.

Algorithm (independent oracle: HTTP spec behavior, not the code under test):
Test 1: get_root_returns_html
  - Spawn server with CorsConfig { enabled: true, allowed_origins: ["*"] }
  - GET / (no Origin header)
  - Assert: 200 OK
  - Assert: Content-Type header contains 'text/html'
  - Assert: body contains 'usenet-ipfs' (from the landing page title/content)

Test 2: cors_preflight_returns_correct_headers
  - Spawn server with CorsConfig { enabled: true, allowed_origins: ["https://example.com"] }
  - OPTIONS /jmap/api with headers:
      Origin: https://example.com
      Access-Control-Request-Method: POST
      Access-Control-Request-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type
  - Assert: 200 OK (or 204)
  - Assert: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://example.com
  - Assert: Access-Control-Allow-Methods contains POST
  - Assert: Access-Control-Allow-Headers contains authorization (case-insensitive)

Test 3: cors_disabled_no_headers
  - Spawn server with CorsConfig { enabled: false, ... }
  - POST /jmap/api with Origin: https://evil.example.com
  - Assert: response does NOT contain Access-Control-Allow-Origin header

Test 4: cors_wildcard_actual_request
  - Spawn server with CorsConfig { enabled: true, allowed_origins: ["*"] }
  - GET /health with Origin: https://anyapp.example.com
  - Assert: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * in response

Defensive programming:
- Tests must spawn fresh server on random port (use spawn_server helper pattern)
- Tests must not modify global state
- CORS tests must verify absence of credentials header with wildcard origin (security invariant)

Acceptance: all 4 tests pass with cargo test --package usenet-ipfs-mail.
